bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 61
test "$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=gace-createvdobot --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll -q | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 62
# The expected public hostname MUST already serve this bot. Do not create DNS or tunnel.
if curl --silent --show-error --location --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 12 --output /dev/null --fail 'https://shop.hentaigay.org/shop' 2>/dev/null; then
 echo EXISTING_SHOP_HTTPS=PASS
 exit 0
fi
if pgrep -x cloudflared >/dev/null || docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -qi cloudflared; then
 echo EXISTING_CLOUDFLARED_PROCESS=PRESENT
 exit 73
fi
if test -d /etc/cloudflared || test -d /home/gace/.cloudflared; then
 echo EXISTING_CLOUDFLARED_CONFIG_DIR=PRESENT
 exit 74
fi
echo EXISTING_SHOP_HTTPS_AND_TUNNEL=NOT_FOUND
exit 72
